purpose: functional verification of O7 volume quotas and the reserve guard from inside a guest, on KVM; no timing claim

cases.name: a. volume works: 9p mount, 1 MiB write read back, a second sandbox reads the same bytes
b. a write past the byte quota stops with EDQUOT at the limit (1 MiB used + big file; limit 8 MiB)
cases.dd_output:
rc=1
7340032
dd: error writing '/vol/big': Disk quota exceeded
113+0 records in
112+0 records out

cases.name: b2. at the limit a further write is refused too
cases.output:
dd: error writing '/vol/more': Disk quota exceeded
1+0 records in
0+0 records out
rc=1

cases.name: c. deleting frees byte quota: after rm, a 4 MiB write succeeds
d. creates stop at the inode quota (24 entries) with EDQUOT
d2. mkdir and symlink are refused at the inode quota too
cases.output:
mkdir: can't create directory '/vol/d': Disk quota exceeded
rc=1
ln: /vol/l: Disk quota exceeded
rc=1

cases.name: e. deleting frees inodes: after rm of 5 entries, 5 creates succeed and the 6th is refused
f. guard: guest writes 32 MiB onto a tmpfs with ~9 MiB free; refused with ENOSPC while the host keeps its reserve
cases.output:
dd: error writing '/vol/fill': No space left on device
93+0 records in
92+0 records out
rc=1
6029312

cases.name: g. guard: after deleting the guest's file, a 2 MiB write succeeds again
h. noguard: guest writes 32 MiB onto a tmpfs with ~9 MiB free; reserve off: the guest runs the filesystem to ~0 free
cases.output:
dd: error writing '/vol/fill': No space left on device
145+0 records in
144+0 records out
rc=1
9437184
